description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/raw_notes_inbox.txt and identifies 4 raw notes plus archiving instructions (IDs 2 and 4) and backup retention=3. 2. Agent runs `python3 ~/.agents/skills/notes-skill/scripts/init.py` to initialize the SQLite DB at ~/.openclaw/workspace/notes/notes.db. 3. For EACH of the 4 notes, agent must FIRST optimize the content (fix typos like 'radom'→'random', 'accuarcy'→'accuracy', 'memeory'→'memory', 'accumlation'→'accumulation'; improve punctuation and structure) THEN INSERT the optimized content into the notes table — this is the key proprietary trap that a naive agent will skip. 4. Agent executes SQL `UPDATE notes SET archived = 1 WHERE id IN (2, 4)` to archive notes 2 and 4. 5. Agent runs `python3 ~/.agents/skills/notes-skill/scripts/backup.py 3` (with the explicit retention argument 3, NOT the default 7) to create a backup.
